charts.title: TOI-6383 A b: orbits around TOI-6383 A
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6383 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6383 A b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Bernabò et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..273B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BERNAB_AMP_OGRAVE__ET_AL__2024): P 1.79058695 d

charts.title: TOI-6383 A b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6383 A b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (73) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 328513434, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
